fuente: FAO ECOCROP (species sheets, ecocrop.apps.fao.org) and FAO Land & Water («Crop information») for pH and texture; FAO-29, Table 4, for salinity (via opciones_b3.json); Gutiérrez González et al. (2022) for pecan nutrients. All read on Nov 14, 2026; each block with its link
nota: GENERAL worldwide ranges: they are not trials in DR-005. Several crops grown in the area fall outside their general pH range at the map pH (~8.1); the soil map is a 250 m model. Do not use it as a filter that rules options out: it is one more piece of evidence

nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)
nutrientes.etiqueta: [V] article abstract; no figures per field
